name: bot_lock
_comment: T169: bots lock through the shared lock system (V15). Every mech (2 filler bots per team + bot-driven server/client players) carries rocket + arc (requires_lock) + rifle; before T169 _update_lock ran only for human input, so bot rockets/arc never fired. lock_target: client lock state agrees with the server for bot mechs too (bots broadcast like players) and >= 2 mechs lock at some point.
